title: Chegada — progressão por detalhes
direction: Pedido do Vitor: crescer em detalhes e quantidade de objetos que tornam a cena interessante, mantendo luz semelhante; Holográfica com pouco ou nenhum efeito holográfico.

design.common: Bebê, caixa e mantinha; ambiente básico.
design.shiny: Primeiros brinquedos, cortina e mais textura.
design.rare: Cesta, tigela, livros, mobiliário e padrões.
design.holographic: Cantinho completo, bolsa de chegada, pelúcia, pantufas e detalhes de acabamento.

variants.label: Comum
variants.detail: TIER 1 / COMMON — SIMPLE ARRIVAL. Just the baby in the box with his cream/red blanket, a plain red/cream rug with simple rings, wooden floor with few broad planks, a plain left window with no decorative curtain, a simple plant pot at right with a few broad leaves, one simple little framed picture. Remove the rope ball and bone-shaped biscuit from the reference and add no other objects. Simplify ENVIRONMENTAL linework and textures into clean broad shapes while preserving polished expressive puppy quality. Calm attractive minimalist composition with clear negative space, not dull or unfinished. Lighting must remain soft ordinary daylight.
variants.prompt: Create ONE edited variation of the supplied 'Chegada' illustration for a FOUR-TIER DETAIL PROGRESSION experiment. The user wants rarity expressed through progressively more interesting SCENE DETAIL AND NUMBER OF MEANINGFUL OBJECTS, NOT progressively brighter lighting. ALL TIERS MUST USE THE SAME calm soft warm natural daytime window light, the same exposure, contrast and color temperature. No extra golden glow, bloom, sparkles, magical particles, star glints, rainbow, iridescence or holographic bands AT ANY TIER. Even the tier named Holographic is simply the MOST RICHLY ILLUSTRATED version, with no foil effect. Preserve the same lovingly drawn newborn Yorkshire Tiro in every tier: extremely tiny TWO MONTH OLD compact baby, floppy ears, black crown and back, tan eyebrows muzzle chest and paws, big brown eyes, innocent head tilt, front paws over front cardboard box edge. Same baby proportions, same camera and central size, never older, never upright ears. Same ordinary brown cardboard arrival box and same cream blanket with red stripe draped over left flap. Maintain the underlying room layout: window LEFT, plant RIGHT, framed picture behind, round red/cream rug and wooden floor. Same polished 2D animated storybook drawing with fine dark outlines, silky fur tufts and cel shading. Preserve this central first-arrival memory. Make every image a cohesive intentionally designed scene, not a collage or random object pile. Extra objects should feel like a family warmly preparing to receive a tiny puppy. Puppy face and box remain the strong focal point; peripheral objects do not overlap his face. No people or other living animals. No letters, words, labels, UI or card border. Square full bleed illustration, important objects remain inside central 85 percent for album crop. TIER 1 / COMMON — SIMPLE ARRIVAL. variants.label: Brilhante
variants.detail: TIER 2 / SHINY — A FEW FIRST BELONGINGS. Keep exact central baby/box/blanket composition. Add TWO clear foreground objects: the little red-and-cream rope ball and a small bone-shaped biscuit placed at lower right as in original reference. Add simple cream curtains to left window, a little more natural wood grain and leaf detail, a modest braided edge on same rug and slightly more woven texture in same blanket. This is a modest step up from common: only these few belongings, no baskets, luggage or shelves yet. SAME soft ordinary daylight as common, absolutely no extra glow, glitter or shine despite tier name.

variants.label: Rara
variants.detail: TIER 3 / RARE — THE WELCOMING CORNER. Retain baby/box/blanket, rope ball and bone biscuit in same locations. Add a small woven basket at the LEFT BACK edge of rug holding one folded spare cream blanket, a low unobtrusive wooden shelf against the BACK wall with two small closed books and a plain ceramic dog bowl nearby. Curtain hems now have fine stitched botanical trim, the rug now has a tasteful red/cream woven floral pattern, cardboard has subtle authentic corrugated edges, plant leaves have veins and a few new shoots, blanket has clearly drawn soft woven stitches. These additional objects tell that the family prepared his corner. Clearly more detail and a few more objects than tier 2, with deliberate airy spacing. SAME soft ordinary daylight, no magical or metallic effects, no brighter golden lighting.

variants.label: Holográfica
variants.detail: TIER 4 / HOLOGRAPHIC NAME ONLY — THE RICHEST NARRATIVE SCENE, NOT LIGHT EFFECTS. Keep same exact baby/box/blanket and the established rope ball, biscuit, basket, bowl and small back shelf from tier 3. Develop the welcoming home corner further with a small soft PLUSH puppy toy peeking out of the blanket basket (clearly an inanimate fabric toy with button eyes and visible seam), a little canvas arrival/travel bag propped behind the basket, a neatly arranged pair of cozy slippers beside the far rug edge and a tiny second potted plant on the existing shelf. Add fine storybook craftsmanship: intricate but tasteful woven floral rug and braid, detailed blanket stitches, soft curtain embroidery, believable cardboard fold lines, subtle grain and carved shelf edges, individual plant leaves and delicate texture on little objects. The extra objects are arranged as a harmonious still life AROUND the unchanged central baby, not cluttering his face or box. This tier must be conspicuously richer in INTERESTING THINGS TO NOTICE than tier 3 and far richer than common, while keeping at least some clear floor/air around box. SAME restrained natural daytime lighting and exposure as all tiers. Absolutely NO sparkles, no star glints, no iridescent sheen, no rainbow, no gold halo, no bloom or magic. Highest rarity is richness of illustrated scene, not brightness.
